name: Henesys Field
description: Rolling meadows dotted with mushrooms. Perfect for beginners.
bossMechanic: Summons minion mushrooms. Kill them before they heal her.

name: Florina Beach
description: A breezy coastal strip south of Henesys. Ribbon pigs, crabs and jellyfish rule the shore.
bossMechanic: Tide surge - arena floods every 12 seconds, reducing DPS by 30%. Clear before the next wave.

name: Ellinia Treetops
description: Towering blue trees housing fairies and flying creatures.
bossMechanic: Inflicts Curse debuff that halves DPS for 4 seconds.

name: Kerning City Sewers
description: Dark underground tunnels crawling with thugs and lizards.
bossMechanic: Steals 15% of meso rewards on boss stage. Defeat quickly.

name: Perion Wasteland
description: A scorched wasteland where warriors first found glory.
bossMechanic: Armored phases - damage reduced by 60% until staggered at 50% HP.

name: Sleepywood Dungeon
description: An ancient dungeon beneath a sleepy town, sealed for good reason.
bossMechanic: Absorbs nearby slimes to restore HP. AOE clear bonuses apply.

name: Ludibrium Clocktower
description: A giant toy clocktower where blocks and dolls have come to life.
bossMechanic: Rewinds time - restores 25% HP every 8 seconds. Burst it down.

name: Omega Sector
description: A secret military base guarding against extra-terrestrial threats.
bossMechanic: Energy shield absorbs 40% damage. Disabled for 5 seconds after AOE hit.

name: Orbis Cloud City
description: A magical city floating above the mountain peaks. Celestial guardians and nependeaths block the way to El Nath.
bossMechanic: Petal storm blinds the arena for 5 seconds. Cooldown-based skills deal 2x during the blind window.

name: El Nath Ice Fields
description: Frozen tundra at the roof of the world. Brutal cold slows progress.
bossMechanic: Blizzard attack freezes for 3 seconds every 15 seconds. Time skills around freeze.

name: Ariant Colosseum
description: A desert city built around a sand warrior colosseum. Scorpions and dune beasts clash in the arena.
bossMechanic: Sandstorm phase - skills locked for 6s. Passive DPS only during storm, then burst window opens.

name: Ice Valley II
description: Deep ice caverns where ancient demons were sealed away.
bossMechanic: Dark aura halves healing. Activates at 30% HP - burst kill required.

name: Phantom Forest
description: A haunted forest bordering Ludibrium. Wraiths, boogies and dark stumps guard an ancient cursed path.
bossMechanic: Curse mark - boss curses hero, reducing DPS by 50% for 8 seconds once at 40% HP.

name: Aqua Road
description: Underwater highways teeming with sea monsters and ancient ruins.
bossMechanic: Spawns twin form - both must die within 10 stages of each other.

name: Golden Temple
description: A gilded shrine protected by goblin warriors and sacred guardians. Legendary drops await the worthy.
bossMechanic: Golden shield reflects 30% damage at full health. Breaks permanently once HP falls below 60%.

name: Minar Forest
description: Ancient forest home to dragons and scholars of lost magic.
bossMechanic: Dragon Breath deals triple damage once per boss fight. Block with Shield Wall.

name: Edelstein Underground
description: Industrial tunnels beneath the resistance city. Mechanical monstrosities and boulder munchers roam the tunnels.
bossMechanic: Shield rotation - boss alternates immune phases every 10s. Only unblocked phase takes damage.

name: Dragon Nest
description: The sacred hatching grounds of Maple World's eldest dragons.
bossMechanic: Aerial phase - grounded attacks deal 50% less. Use Snipe or burst skills.

name: Ghost Park
description: A haunted amusement park deep in Masteria. Sage cats and spectral beasts stalk the abandoned rides.
bossMechanic: Moon blast - charges every 20s dealing massive damage. Use Shield Wall or time a heal before it fires.

name: Mu Lung Gardens
description: Serene bamboo gardens where ancient masters train in forgotten arts.
bossMechanic: Kung Fu stance: randomly immune to physical or magic for 5 seconds.

name: Azwan Ruins
description: Ancient ruins on the edge of Nihal Desert. Desert soldiers and undead grave robbers swarm the sand tombs.
bossMechanic: Sand tomb - traps hero for 4 seconds. Break free with any skill activation or take 3x chip damage.

name: Nihal Desert
description: Endless dunes hiding nomads, sandworms, and buried treasure.
bossMechanic: Sandstorm blocks skills for 6 seconds. Passive damage only during storm.

name: Mirror World
description: A distorted reflection of Maple World where copies of classic monsters fight with mirrored patterns.
bossMechanic: Reflection phase - deals your own DPS back at you for 4s once below 50%. Pause burst until it ends.

name: Magatia Alchemy City
description: A city of alchemists split between the Zenumist and Alcadno factions.
bossMechanic: Regenerates 3% HP per second. Must be killed within 60 seconds.

name: Singapore Streets
description: Neon-lit city streets where gangs and monsters battle for turf.
bossMechanic: Two-eye mechanic - each eye has separate HP. Left eye heals if right survives.

name: Future Henesys
description: A dark future timeline where Henesys fell to the Black Mage. Shadow versions of classic monsters haunt the ruins.
bossMechanic: Time rewind - boss resets to 70% HP once. Only happens once - burst it below 50% before the rewind triggers.

name: New Leaf City
description: A dark alternate Maple World overrun by shadow creatures.
bossMechanic: Rage form at 40% HP - all damage doubled both ways. Execute skill instant-kills.

name: Crimsonwood Keep
description: Ancient stronghold of warriors sworn to oppose the Black Mage.
bossMechanic: Headless phase - attacks miss 50% of the time. Deal 5A - damage when head returns.

name: Kritias Invasion
description: A frozen city under constant invasion. Corrupted ice constructs controlled by an unknown force patrol the streets.
bossMechanic: Freeze pulse - stuns hero for 3s every 15s. DPS stored during stun is released as a burst on recovery.

name: Zipangu - Mushroom Shrine
description: Sacred shrine grounds haunted by spirits and celestial beasts.
bossMechanic: Illusion split - creates 2 clones. Only the real one takes damage.

name: Tynerum Demon World
description: A volcanic demon realm accessed through the Black Mage's rift. Demon soldiers and lava beasts flood the approach.
bossMechanic: Demon Rage - all three heads activate at once below 33% HP, tripling attack speed for 10 seconds.

name: Leafre - Dragon Skies
description: High above the canopy where ancient sky dragons patrol the clouds.
bossMechanic: Lightning storm charges every 10 stages - one-shots if not burst down first.

name: Black Heaven Sky Fortress
description: A massive airship fortress commanded by Gelimer. Iron reapers and combat drones defend every deck.
bossMechanic: Overcharge blast - deals 5x damage once but telegraphs 8s early. Use Shield Wall to block or take the hit.

name: Temple of Time
description: An eternal monument where time itself fractures. Only the worthy may enter.
bossMechanic: Resets stage timer - boss resets to full HP once unless killed in one tick burst.

name: Black Mage's Lair
description: The final darkness. The source of all evil in Maple World awaits.
bossMechanic: World Seal - all DPS cut by 80% for 5 seconds. Relics and Rebirth count offset the seal.

name: Cernium
description: A holy city burning with Cernium flames. Corrupted court knights and sacred tomes fight for the last sacred ground.
bossMechanic: Divine Flame ignites for 6s - DPS doubled but hero takes 2x chip damage. Time healing around the flame.

name: Arcane River - Vanishing Journey
description: Dreamlike waters where memories drift and monsters mutate with arcane currents.
bossMechanic: Arcane tide rises every few seconds and cuts damage unless burst windows are timed.

name: Hotel Arcus
description: A luxurious hotel turned dark by void energy. Robotic staff and desperado gunmen hold every floor.
bossMechanic: Lockdown mode - blocks all skill use for 8s at the start of each phase. Passive DPS only during lockdown.

name: Moonbridge Frontline
description: A broken sky bridge where void beasts clash with the last defenders.
bossMechanic: Moon fracture marks the arena. Survive burst waves to expose the core.

name: Odium
description: A void dimension of pure machine intelligence. Angler robots and void sentinels protect an ancient mechanical core.
bossMechanic: Core singularity - instantly kills hero if DPS falls below threshold for 5s straight. Keep pressure constant.

name: Labyrinth of Suffering
description: A cursed maze where corrupted memories hunt anything still alive.
bossMechanic: Pain sigils weaken recovery. Break shield windows to keep pressure up.

name: Reverse City
description: An inverted shadow dimension where reality is fractured. Anti-monsters mirror your attacks with lethal precision.
bossMechanic: Reality inversion - your strongest skill is reflected back once per fight at full power. Save burst for after reflection.

name: Limina - End of the World
description: The final frontier where reality collapses under pure void pressure.
bossMechanic: Reality collapse seals most buffs until the Watcher is staggered at phase breaks.
